relations.subject: Masato Fujii
relations.object: Institute for Research in Humanities, Kyoto University
relations.evidence: Masato Fujii was Professor of Indology at the Institute for Research in Humanities, Kyoto University from 1993 to March 2020, when he retired at the age of 65.
